issues.title: new_click method missing must_use attribute
issues.description: The new_click method returns a TrayIconEvent that represents an important event which should not be ignored. Factory methods that create event objects should be marked with #[must_use] to prevent accidentally creating an event without handling it, which could lead to silent logic errors.
issues.rule_name: Functions Returning Values Should Be Marked with must_use Where Appropriate

issues.title: Inverted mouse button state mapping in tray icon event conversion
issues.description: The From implementation for converting tray_icon::MouseButtonState to MouseButtonState has the Up and Down states inverted. When a mouse button is released (Up) from the underlying tray_icon library, it's incorrectly mapped to Down in the Tauri TrayIconEvent, and vice versa. This will cause all tray icon click handlers to receive the opposite button state than what actually occurred, breaking event handling logic that depends on distinguishing between button press and release events. The new_click factory method added in this PR uses MouseButtonState::default() which is Up, but when real events are converted through this From implementation, the states will be backwards.

issues.title: PatternJavascript struct gated behind isolation feature breaks brownfield pattern
issues.description: The PatternJavascript struct was moved behind a #[cfg(feature = "isolation")] gate, but this struct is used in webview initialization code (manager/webview.rs line 131) for all pattern types including Pattern::Brownfield. When the isolation feature is disabled, the PatternJavascript struct won't be defined, causing a compilation error in webview.rs when it tries to instantiate PatternJavascript for brownfield applications. This change in the derive attribute placement breaks the fundamental pattern system for non-isolation builds, preventing any Tauri application that doesn't use the isolation pattern from compiling.

issues.title: Config schema/source changed without corresponding generated artifacts update
issues.description: This PR modifies `crates/tauri-utils/src/config.rs` (a source file explicitly called out by Rule 14 as driving generated artifacts such as schemas). The diff does not include any updates to the corresponding generated outputs (e.g., regenerated JSON schemas / other generated artifacts that depend on this config). Under Rule 14, changes to this file require regenerating and committing the generated files to keep them in sync.
issues.rule_name: Generated Files Must Be Kept in Sync with Source Code

issues.title: v1 config schema/source changed without corresponding generated artifacts update
issues.description: This PR also modifies `crates/tauri-utils/src/config_v1/mod.rs`, which is part of configuration/schema definitions. The diff does not include any regenerated artifacts that would normally need updating when configuration schema-related code changes (as required by Rule 14).
issues.rule_name: Generated Files Must Be Kept in Sync with Source Code

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14395 - chore: fix new clippy warnings (derive default)

structured_output.summary:
The PR clears a batch of new clippy warnings by replacing hand-written `impl Default` blocks with `#[derive(Default)]` plus `#[default]` on the variant, across tauri-utils (both config and config_v1), tauri-cli, tauri-runtime, tauri-bundler, and tauri. Most of the mechanical conversions are correct and preserve behavior. Three changes go beyond that: a `From<tray_icon::MouseButtonState>` mapping in `tauri/src/tray/mod.rs` that now inverts Up and Down, a `#[cfg(feature = "isolation")]` attribute in `tauri/src/pattern.rs` that was left attached to `PatternJavascript` and now gates a struct that is used unconditionally, and a new public `TrayIconEvent::new_click` test helper added to production code.

The tray inversion is a silent behavior change in a public event type that reaches JavaScript. The `pattern.rs` change looks like it breaks builds without the `isolation` feature. Both are one-line-scale problems but should block merge. The `new_click` addition is unrelated to clippy and expands the public API without a caller. Overall I would not approve as-is, though the bulk of the derive refactor is fine.
structured_output.verdictRationale: Two defects are likely to break things: the tray `MouseButtonState` mapping now inverts Up/Down for every tray click event sent to the frontend, and removing the `impl Default` block left `#[cfg(feature = "isolation")]` attached to `PatternJavascript`, which `manager/webview.rs` uses unconditionally, so non-isolation builds should fail to compile. The `new_click` helper is an unrelated public API addition. The remaining derive conversions look correct.

architecture.overview:
Tauri's config, runtime, and tray types are plain Rust enums that the crates share. Several of them carried hand-written `impl Default` blocks that clippy now flags as `derivable_impls`. This PR replaces those blocks with `#[derive(Default)]` plus a `#[default]` attribute on the chosen variant, in tauri-utils (config and config_v1), tauri-runtime, tauri-cli, tauri-bundler, and the tauri crate. Those changes are mechanical and keep the same default values.

Three edits go beyond that pattern. The tray `From<tray_icon::MouseButtonState>` conversion now maps Up to Down and Down to Up. The `#[cfg(feature = "isolation")]` attribute, which used to guard an `impl` block, now sits in front of `PatternJavascript` in `pattern.rs`. A new `TrayIconEvent::new_click` constructor is added to the public API.
steps: Entry point: the tray backend (`tray_icon` crate) emits raw events, which `tauri/src/tray/mod.rs` converts into the public `TrayIconEvent` type through the `From` impls. Those events are serialized to JavaScript.

Default-derive refactor: the `Default` impls for `MouseButtonState`, `MouseButton`, `NsisCompression`, `NSISInstallerMode`, `BundleTarget`, `PatternKind`, `WindowsUpdateInstallMode`, `TitleBarStyle`, `IsolationSide`, and `DeviceEventFilter` are replaced by `#[default]` variants. Defaults are preserved.
Tray conversion (changed): `From<tray_icon::MouseButtonState>` now returns the opposite state, so the button state observed by JavaScript is inverted.

Isolation pattern (changed): `IsolationSide` is still gated by the isolation feature, but the struct `PatternJavascript` that follows now also carries that gate. `manager/webview.rs` constructs it without any cfg.
Test helper (added): `TrayIconEvent::new_click` is a public constructor with no call sites in the repository and no test that uses it.

findings.title: Tray MouseButtonState conversion inverts Up and Down
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/tray/mod.rs`, the `From<tray_icon::MouseButtonState>` impl (around lines 31-38) maps `Up` to `MouseButtonState::Down` and `Down` to `MouseButtonState::Up`. Restore the identity mapping so `tray_icon::MouseButtonState::Up` maps to `MouseButtonState::Up` and `Down` maps to `Down`, as it was on the base commit. Then add a small unit test in the existing `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` that checks both conversions, so a future swap is caught.

findings.title: Isolation cfg now gates PatternJavascript, which is used unconditionally
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/pattern.rs`, the `#[cfg(feature = "isolation")]` attribute at around line 78 is now attached to `PatternJavascript` (line 81) rather than to a removed `impl Default for IsolationSide`. `PatternJavascript` is used unconditionally in `crates/tauri/src/manager/webview.rs` around line 131. Remove that stray cfg attribute so the struct is compiled in all feature combinations, and keep the cfg on `IsolationSide` (line 66) and on the `Pattern::Isolation` match arm. Verify that the crate still builds with and without the `isolation` feature.

findings.title: New public new_click constructor added with no callers
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/tray/mod.rs`, remove the public `TrayIconEvent::new_click` helper (around lines 137-151), which has no callers and is unrelated to the clippy fix. If a test needs a click event, construct it inside the existing `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block instead, following the literal used in `tray_event_json_serialization`. Keep the public API unchanged.

findings.title: Doc comment on MouseButtonState::Up describes the wrong state
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/tray/mod.rs`, the doc comments on `MouseButtonState` (around lines 24-28) are swapped: `Up` is documented as "Mouse button pressed" and `Down` as "Mouse button released". Swap them so `Up` documents release and `Down` documents press. Do not change the enum variants or the derive.
